problem_statement:
`UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` / `LOWER_CASE` `NamingStrategyImpls` fold case using JVM default locale (Turkish-I bug)

## Describe the bug

`NamingStrategyImpls.UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.translate()` (line 83) and `LOWER_CASE.translate()` (line 96) invoke `String.toUpperCase()` / `toLowerCase()` without a `Locale` argument. Under Turkish (`tr_TR`) or Azerbaijani (`az_AZ`) JVM default locale, the Latin letter `i` maps to `İ` (U+0130) rather than `I` (U+0049), so property-name matching for Java identifiers containing `i` / `I` silently fails.

## Version Information

`2.13.0` and later (since `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` strategy was added in #3238).

## To Reproduce

```java
Locale.setDefault(Locale.forLanguageTag("tr-TR"));

ObjectMapper mapper = JsonMapper.builder()
    .propertyNamingStrategy(PropertyNamingStrategies.UPPER_SNAKE_CASE)
    .build();

class User { public boolean isAdmin; }

User u = mapper.readValue("{\"IS_ADMIN\": true}", User.class);
// English locale: u.isAdmin == true
// Turkish locale: u.isAdmin == false (silent mapping failure)
```

| Input → strategy             | English locale | Turkish locale |
|------------------------------|----------------|----------------|
| `isAdmin` (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) | `IS_ADMIN`     | `İS_ADMİN`     |
| `ClientID` (LOWER_CASE)      | `clientid`     | `clientıd`     |

## Expected behavior

ASCII case mapping regardless of JVM default locale, matching the existing pattern in `EnumNamingStrategies` (same package), which already uses `Locale.ROOT`.

## Additional context

- Regression of the locale-handling lesson from #953 (closed in 2.11.0) and #2563.
- `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` strategy added in #3238 (2021-08) reintroduced the anti-pattern.
- PR against `2.x` ready.
